When you speak of discipline what do you do exactly?

Set up rules for the dog. Be clear in what I want from them. Encourage and reward positive behavior. Find out what drives them, and turn their chores into a game. Bad behavior gets ignored (I'm not going to listen to a barking dog) or worked out by distractions or by simply slowly integrating triggers into their environment up to the point they no longer are of interest. I do not believe in physical punishment for dogs, since this can be avoided and simply shows lack of discipline and patience from the side of the owner.
